The fastest way is WhatsApp at +62 896-7407-2020. You can also email bali@mychef.id or call the same number. We usually reply within minutes on WhatsApp. Who is Sofia and what does she handle? Sofia is our Fine Dining Concierge. She handles tasting-menu reservations, dietary preferences, wine pairings, and fine-dining experiences at your villa. How quickly will myCHEF respond? We typically reply within minutes on WhatsApp. For email enquiries, expect a response within a few hours during business hours. Can I call instead of using WhatsApp? Yes. You can call +62 896-7407-2020 directly. Our lines are open daily from 08:00 to 22:00 WITA. What information should I include in my first message? Let us know your name, the service you are interested in, your villa or location in Bali, group size, and preferred date. The more detail, the faster we can help. Do you have an office I can visit in Bali? Yes. Our office is at Jl. Tukad Barito Timur III No.16, Denpasar Selatan, Bali. We serve all of Bali including Seminyak, Canggu, Ubud, Uluwatu, and Sanur. Can I email myCHEF instead? Absolutely. Send detailed proposals or longer enquiries to bali@mychef.id and we will route them to the right concierge. What are your business hours? We are open daily from 08:00 to 22:00 WITA (Bali time). WhatsApp messages outside these hours are answered first thing the next morning. ⭐ 560+ events served · 12,000+ guests · 500+ villa bookings Prices shown are estimates and do not include service charge or VAT. Service charge (10%) and government tax (11%) will be added to your final quote.
